angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 253,931 km at 30.06 pc = 0.11 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 33.2642 +/- 0.0154 mas (same row, RUWE 1.32): 30.06 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.365 +/- 0.012 solar radii from Serrano Bell et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-4438 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260713333S/abstract): 253,931 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.345 +/- 0.018 solar masses from Serrano Bell et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-4438 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260713333S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3501 +/- 70 K from Serrano Bell et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-4438 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260713333S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Serrano Bell et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-4438 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260713333S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-4438.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.851, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4438 (pscomppars): spectral type M3.5 V, from Serrano Bell et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260713333S/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, G 182-34: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4438 (pscomppars): [M/H] 0.07 dex, from Serrano Bell et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260713333S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4438 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.76802, from Serrano Bell et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260713333S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4438 (pscomppars): age 4.8 Gyr, from Serrano Bell et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260713333S/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4438 (pscomppars): rotation period 77.6 d, from Serrano Bell et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260713333S/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4438 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Goffo et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...685A.147G/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
